== Summary ==
[[Hayes Hunter]] (right, with lanyard) holds his 2024 Hall of Fame trophy, engraved "Hayes Hunter, 2024, Star Wars CCG Hall of Fame". The wrap-up says his brother [[Eric Hunter]] presented it.

* '''Event:''' [[2024 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2024-09-21
* '''Camera date:''' 2024-09-21 (Day 1; posted that evening)
* '''Identification:''' [[Hayes Hunter]] (right): the trophy he holds is engraved with his name, and his face matches the [[:File:2024 World Championship Top 8.jpg|Top 8 photo]]. The man at left is not named in the post.

== Source ==
Posted in the #2024-worlds-bochum channel of the Players Committee Slack (starwarsccg.slack.com), 2024-09-21. Original file name: 1000006044.jpg (2268×4032); Slack file id F07N1K54RV5.
